caption: A steel ruler is held flat on a desk with part sticking over the edge; the free end is flicked and it waggles up and down before coming to rest.

sa.check: A steel ruler lies on a desk with part sticking out over the edge.
The ruler is held down on the desk.
The free end waggles up and down and comes to rest.
The flick comes first and the waggle follows.

pc.expect: The ruler is still until the flick, waggles from the flick, and does not start again by itself.
pc.fail: The end moves before the flick; or waggles with no flick; or starts again after resting.

pc.expect: The waggle shrinks: the tip's excursions get smaller until it is still.
pc.fail: The swings grow; or stay constant for the whole clip; or the tip stops dead at the top of a swing.

pc.expect: The ruler bends elastically at the desk edge: the overhang flexes and returns straight, and the held part stays flat.
pc.fail: The ruler kinks and stays bent; or bends like rubber into a large curve; or the held part lifts and waggles too.

pc.expect: The tip moves up and down about the straight position.
pc.fail: The tip swings side to side; or rotates; or the ruler slides off the desk.

pc.expect: One ruler; it passes through nothing, and the hand and desk keep their shape.
pc.fail: The ruler duplicates; or passes through the desk; or vanishes; or the fingers pass through the ruler.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The ruler's markings and the desk stay the same.
pc.fail: The markings change; or the ruler changes length; or desk items move.
